Thanks Ben —

Sam — quick note on scope so we can tailor slides:
1) Connectivity: we will walk through three patterns (VPN, private interconnect, VPC peering + NAT) and show cost/latency tradeoffs. Please flag if you already rule out any pattern.
2) Network: expected ports/egress for model pull, KV cache, and metrics (we'll include a one-page rule set).
3) IAM: service account isolation, short-lived credentials, and KMS access for logs/artifacts.
4) Logging & retention: what the platform logs and where we can push audit logs for compliance.

If you can share your on-prem edge IP ranges and a quick diagram before Monday, that will make the session more actionable. Otherwise we will run with examples.

I can lead the 90-minute session and leave 20 min for procurement/security Q&A.

Proposed confirm: Tue 2027-03-09 13:00-14:30 PST (we'll send the calendar invite).

Best,
